responsibility: Provides the generated mapping from SysV4-specific PowerPC option names in gcc/config/rs6000/sysv4.opt to their GCC manual anchors. It is the documentation-side companion to the SysV4 option table, covering ABI, small-data, endianness, relocatable, 32/64-bit, secure-PLT, and related System V option spellings so generated option metadata can point at the correct manual entries.
